---
name: Feature or task
about: Planned work with explicit acceptance criteria
title: "feat(area): short imperative title"
labels: enhancement, roadmap
---

## Context
Why this matters, in two or three sentences.

## What is missing today
The concrete gap in the current code (name files/functions), or the missing
capability for a user.

## Proposal
The intended design. Mention alternatives if there is a real choice to make.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A testable, concrete outcome.
- [ ] Another one.
- [ ] `cargo test --release` green; `--help`, `schema` and docs updated.

## Notes
Dependencies on other issues (`Depends on #12`), links, measurements, and any
before/after numbers required by the issue.
